About us

Furniture manufacturer in West Pune.

Pune Furnitures is a furniture manufacturer with a showroom and workshop on Paud Road, Kothrud. We serve West Pune, the rest of Pune and PCMC, and make custom furniture for homes and offices.

As a sofa maker in Pune, we build custom sofas and sofa sets: L-shape, luxury and wooden sofas in your size, fabric and finish. Visit the showroom and sit on one first.

For the rest of the home we make custom wardrobes, beds, bedroom furniture, TV units and modular furniture, plus living room revolving chairs. For offices we make office chairs and office furniture.

We also repair sofas and chairs in Pune, from sofa upholstery and foam replacement to office and revolving chair repair. Send photos on WhatsApp for an estimate.

FAQ

Quick answers.

Do you make custom sofas in Pune?

Yes. We build custom sofas and sofa sets, including L-shape, luxury and wooden sofas, in your size, fabric and finish.

Do you repair office and revolving chairs?

Yes. We repair office, revolving, executive and computer chairs. Send photos on WhatsApp or visit the showroom for an estimate.

Why are prices not listed?

Each piece depends on size, fabric and finish. Send your details and we reply with a quote.

Do you deliver outside Pune?

Delivery is free across Pune and PCMC. For anywhere else, ask us when you enquire.

Can you repair my old sofa?

Yes. Send photos through the form or WhatsApp and we will estimate the repair.

Can I see the furniture before ordering?

Yes. Our showroom and workshop are on Paud Road, Kothrud. Use Get directions below.
